zh-CN.title: 桌面书写台更专注
items: 桌面聊天输入区现在完整铺开，移除了发送按钮与字数提示
点击任意书写空白处即可输入，也可拖动工具栏边界调整书写高度

en.title: A more focused desktop writing desk
items: The desktop chat editor now uses the full width without a send button or character counter
Click anywhere on the writing canvas to type, or drag the toolbar edge to resize it
